description: Catalog of opening and test-position books hosted in this repository. Each book is a zip archive holding a single EPD or PGN file.

metadata_notes.path: Archive location relative to the repository root and to base_url.
metadata_notes.url: Direct download URL of the archive (base_url + path).
metadata_notes.archive: The zip archive as downloaded. It contains exactly one member named file_name; check size and sha256 before extracting.
metadata_notes.content: Size and SHA-256 of the extracted file, byte for byte.
metadata_notes.format: epd: one position per line (FEN, optionally followed by EPD operations). pgn: move sequences from the standard starting position, or from a FEN tag.
metadata_notes.variant: standard, or chess960 for Fischer Random and Double Fischer Random positions; engines need UCI_Chess960 and match runners a Chess960/fischerandom variant.
metadata_notes.category: openings: starting points for engine matches. endgames: late-game positions. stalemates: positions for testing stalemate detection.
metadata_notes.positions: Counts by side to move at the end of each line. Ply is the half-move number of that position (0 = starting position); min_ply and max_ply are null when the file does not record move numbers.
metadata_notes.author: Person credited upstream with creating the book; null when not documented.
metadata_notes.source: Where the archive came from. download_url is the exact upstream file; archive_member is set when the book was extracted from a larger archive and rezipped on its own, with the file itself unchanged.
metadata_notes.license: License of the book as declared upstream. spdx_id is null when no license is stated; check the upstream terms before redistributing those books.

books.name: 2 Moves v1
books.description: Opening positions after two moves per side (4 plies) from the standard starting position. An early Stockfish testing book.

books.name: 2 Moves v2
books.description: Two-move opening lines (4 plies), given as move sequences from the standard starting position. An early Stockfish testing book.

books.name: Chess960 3 Moves
books.description: Chess960 starting positions followed by three moves per side (6 plies).
books.notes: Originally from the OpenBench testing framework.

books.name: UHO 4 Moves (+0.90 to +0.99)
books.description: Stefan Pohl's Unbalanced Human Openings: 4-move lines (8 plies) from human games, kept where the final position favours White by +0.90 to +0.99.
books.author: Stefan Pohl

books.name: UHO 6 Moves (+0.90 to +0.99)
books.description: Stefan Pohl's Unbalanced Human Openings: 6-move lines (12 plies) from human games, kept where the final position favours White by +0.90 to +0.99.
books.author: Stefan Pohl

books.name: 8 Moves v3
books.description: Balanced eight-move opening lines (16 plies) from the standard starting position. A long-standing Stockfish testing book.

books.name: UHO 8 Moves (+0.90 to +0.99)
books.description: Stefan Pohl's Unbalanced Human Openings: 8-move lines (16 plies) from human games, kept where the final position favours White by +0.90 to +0.99.
books.author: Stefan Pohl

books.name: UHO 8 Moves Big (+0.80 to +1.09)
books.description: Stefan Pohl's Unbalanced Human Openings (larger set with a wider window): 8-move lines (16 plies) from human games, kept where the final position favours White by +0.80 to +1.09.
books.author: Stefan Pohl

books.name: Braams chessdb 198,350 Lines
books.description: 198,350 opening lines of up to eight moves from human master play. In each line the side to move at the end has an advantage of 0.40 to 1.40 pawns according to chessdb (chessdb.cn).
books.author: Bastiaan Braams

books.name: Closed Positions
books.description: Closed positions taken at ply 8 from long-time-control fishtest games: at least four blocked pawns, at least 26 pieces on the board and a small move tree (perft 5 below 40 million).
books.author: Joost VandeVondele

books.name: DFRC 48-52 v1
books.description: Double Fischer Random positions with 0 to 3 plies played, kept where Stockfish 17.1 at depth 22 predicts a draw rate between 48% and 52%.
books.author: Robert Nürnberg

books.name: DFRC Start Positions
books.description: All 921,600 Double Fischer Random Chess starting positions (independent Chess960 setups for White and Black).
books.notes: Many of these positions are unbalanced by nature.

books.name: Drawkiller Balanced Big
books.description: Stefan Pohl's Drawkiller openings, balanced large set: constructed positions with the kings in opposite corners, designed to lower the draw rate in engine matches.
books.author: Stefan Pohl

books.name: Endgames
books.description: About 158,000 endgame and late-middlegame positions from decisive long-time-control fishtest games, with little non-pawn material and an evaluation that is neither an easy win nor an easy draw.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele

books.name: Endgames chessdb 0.95-1.05
books.description: 107,828 endgame positions from the 2025-11-15 chessdb dump with little non-pawn material, kept where Stockfish's absolute evaluation is between 0.95 and 1.05 pawns.
books.author: Torsten Hellwig

books.name: Chess960 Start Positions
books.description: All 960 Chess960 (Fischer Random) starting positions.

books.name: Hybrid Book Beta
books.description: An early experimental Stockfish testing book. The upstream repository does not document how it was built.

books.name: Noob 2 Moves
books.description: Opening positions after 2 moves per side (4 plies) from the standard starting position.
books.author: noobpwnftw

books.name: Noob 3 Moves
books.description: Opening positions after 3 moves per side (6 plies) from the standard starting position.
books.author: noobpwnftw

books.name: Noob 4 Moves
books.description: Opening positions after 4 moves per side (8 plies) from the standard starting position.
books.author: noobpwnftw

books.name: Noob 5 Moves
books.description: Opening positions after 5 moves per side (10 plies) from the standard starting position.
books.author: noobpwnftw

books.name: Popular Positions Lichess v1
books.description: The 200,000 most frequent positions in rated Lichess games from January 2020 (both players above 1800, time control over 60 seconds), each game read up to its first novelty.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele

books.name: Popular Positions Lichess v2
books.description: As Popular Positions Lichess v1, but restricted to games where both players are rated above 2200.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele

books.name: Popular Positions Lichess v3
books.description: 200,000 positions ranked by how often they occur both in Lichess games (players above 1800) and in long-time-control fishtest games.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele

books.name: Stalemate Traps v1
books.description: 10,796 positions from fishtest games that ended in stalemate, although Stockfish 16 at depth 30 evaluates them as clearly winning (above +2.00). Used to test stalemate detection.
books.author: Robert Nürnberg
books.notes: Lines carry EPD c0/c1 comments with the original and Stockfish 16 evaluations.

books.name: Start Position
books.description: The standard chess starting position only.

books.name: Transpositions chessdb 0.95-1.05
books.description: 200,866 opening positions from the 2026-07-02 chessdb dump with verified transpositions along the principal variation, kept where Stockfish's absolute evaluation is between 0.95 and 1.05 pawns.
books.author: Torsten Hellwig

books.name: UHO 40-60 v1
books.description: Positions from Stefan Pohl's Unbalanced Human Openings, rescored by Stockfish at depth 22 and kept where the predicted win rate is between 40% and 60%.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele, from Stefan Pohl's UHO sets

books.name: UHO 40-60 v2
books.description: UHO 40-60 v1 with some duplicate positions removed.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele, from Stefan Pohl's UHO sets
books.notes: This version has no move counters, so ply depth is not recorded.

books.name: UHO 40-60 v3
books.description: UHO 40-60 v2 with move counters restored.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele, from Stefan Pohl's UHO sets

books.name: UHO 40-60 v4
books.description: UHO 40-60 v3 with duplicate positions removed.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele, from Stefan Pohl's UHO sets

books.name: UHO Lichess 48-52 v1
books.description: About 2.6 million positions seen at least twice within the first 16 plies of Lichess games from January to September 2023, kept where Stockfish predicts a draw rate between 48% and 52%. Either side may have the advantage, typically around one pawn.
books.author: Joost VandeVondele

books.name: UHO MEGA 2022 (+1.10 to +1.49)
books.description: Stefan Pohl's UHO MEGA 2022: eight-move human opening lines (16 plies) whose final position favours White by +1.10 to +1.49 according to Komodo Dragon 2.6.
